title: Introducing Jev-Omni
label: Release note
summary: Text, images, audio, and video. One interface for making decisions.
editorialNote: Adapted from the public Jev-Omni model card.

sections.text: Jev-Omni takes a situation, a question, and a set of options, then returns a probability for each option. It supports text, images, audio, and video.

sections.heading: A model for bounded decisions
sections.text: The output is a distribution over the choices you provide. This makes it useful when an application needs to choose between defined actions. The model produces its decision in one forward pass, without generating a text response.

sections.heading: Explore the release
sections.text: The model card contains the architecture, current benchmark results, setup instructions, and limitations. The weights and reference code are available on Hugging Face, along with an interactive demo.
